description: Bertrand Arthur William Russell, 3rd Earl Russell (18 May 1872 – 2 February 1970), was an English  philosopher, logician, mathematician, and public intellectual. He influenced mathematics, logic, set theory, and various areas of analytic philosophy. He was one of the early 20th century's prominent logicians and a founder of analytic philosophy, along with his predecessor Gottlob Frege, his friend and colleague G.
